description: Search stored official sanctions (OFAC) and maritime-security (UKMTO) records by source, country, date or text. Each row carries the event_id the other geopolitical tools take and its revision history. Paged with limit and offset. Access: API key required, else returns subscription_required with a subscribe link.

after_revision.description: Return revisions newer than this non-negative watermark; 0 disables the incremental filter.

as_of.description: Knowledge cutoff with timezone, e.g. 2024-06-30T23:59:59Z; omit for latest.

country.description: Uppercase ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country link, e.g. US; omit for all countries.

date_basis.description: Which date start_date and end_date filter on.

end_date.description: Inclusive upper date bound, YYYY-MM-DD, e.g. 2024-12-31.

include_undated.description: Retain undated records when start_date or end_date filters are supplied.

offset.description: Zero-based row offset; 0 starts the first page.

search.description: Text filter, at most 160 characters, e.g. sanctions.

source_id.description: Official source ID from source coverage, e.g. ofac_actions; omit for all sources.

start_date.description: Inclusive lower date bound, YYYY-MM-DD, e.g. 2024-01-01.

subtype.description: Exact source-record subtype from history results; omit for all subtypes.

name: geopolitical_history
title: Geopolitical Event History
